metadata.question: Does tropospheric nitrogen dioxide (NO2) levels in Taiwan increase during April 20-May 12, 2020 compared to February 10-25, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: Sentinel-5P OFFL NO2 ("COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2") - Date 1: February 10-25, 2020 - Date 2: April 20-May 12, 2020 - Location: Taiwan (approximate center ~23.5°N, 121°E, use a polygon covering the island) 2. Masking strategy: - Sentinel-5P NO2 has a quality assurance band (qa_value). Should filter for qa_value > 0.5 or 0.75 for good quality pixels - Also check for valid NO2 values (tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density) 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: If mean NO2 values are calculated successfully (could be low but not None/NaN) - C1: If either period has 0 images - C2: If after QA filtering, no valid pixels remain - C3: If the calculated mean is None/NaN - A: If April-May mean > Feb mean (increase) - B: If April-May mean <= Feb mean (no increase) ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions taiwan = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[119.5, 21.9], [122.0, 21.9], [122.0, 25.3], [119.5, 25.3], [119.5, 21.9]] ]) date1_start = '2020-02-10' date1_end = '2020-02-26' date2_start = '2020-04-20' date2_end = '2020-05-13' # 2. Data Acquisition & Check col1 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') \ .filterBounds(taiwan) \ .filterDate(date1_start, date1_end) \ .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density') col2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') \ .filterBounds(taiwan) \ .filterDate(date2_start, date2_end) \ .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density') size1 = col1.size().getInfo() size2 = col2.size().getInfo() print(f"Feb 2020 Images: {size1}") print(f"Apr-May 2020 Images: {size2}") if size1 == 0 or size2 == 0: print("Empty collection for one or both periods.") print("C1") else: # 3. Processing - Apply QA mask and calculate means def mask_no2(image): qa = image.select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density') return image.updateMask(qa.gt(0)) col1_masked = col1.map(mask_no2) col2_masked = col2.map(mask_no2) img1 = col1_masked.mean() img2 = col2_masked.mean() # Check pixel counts count1 = img1.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=taiwan, scale=5000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo() count2 = img2.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=taiwan, scale=5000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo() print(f"Feb Valid Pixels: {count1}") print(f"Apr-May Valid Pixels: {count2}") if count1 == 0 or count2 == 0: print("No valid pixels after masking.") print("C2") else: # 4. Calculation mean1 = img1.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=taiwan, scale=5000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo() mean2 = img2.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=taiwan, scale=5000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo() print(f"Feb Mean NO2: {mean1}") print(f"Apr-May Mean NO2: {mean2}") # 5. Validation & Final Answer if mean1 is None or mean2 is None: print("Calculation failed - None values.") print("C3") else: print(f"Change: {((mean2 - mean1) / mean1 * 100):.2f}%") if mean2 > mean1: print("NO2 levels increased in Apr-May 2020 vs Feb 2020.") print("A") else: print("NO2 levels did not increase in Apr-May 2020 vs Feb 2020.") print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
taiwan = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
    [[119.5, 21.9], [122.0, 21.9], [122.0, 25.3], [119.5, 25.3], [119.5, 21.9]]
])

date1_start = '2020-02-10'
date1_end = '2020-02-26'
date2_start = '2020-04-20'
date2_end = '2020-05-13'

# 2. Data Acquisition & Check
col1 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') \
    .filterBounds(taiwan) \
    .filterDate(date1_start, date1_end) \
    .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density')

col2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') \
    .filterBounds(taiwan) \
    .filterDate(date2_start, date2_end) \
    .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density')

size1 = col1.size().getInfo()
size2 = col2.size().getInfo()

print(f"Feb 2020 Images: {size1}")
print(f"Apr-May 2020 Images: {size2}")

if size1 == 0 or size2 == 0:
    print("Empty collection for one or both periods.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # 3. Processing - Apply QA mask and calculate means
    def mask_no2(image):
        qa = image.select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density')
        return image.updateMask(qa.gt(0))
    
    col1_masked = col1.map(mask_no2)
    col2_masked = col2.map(mask_no2)
    
    img1 = col1_masked.mean()
    img2 = col2_masked.mean()
    
    # Check pixel counts
    count1 = img1.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=taiwan,
        scale=5000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo()
    
    count2 = img2.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=taiwan,
        scale=5000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo()
    
    print(f"Feb Valid Pixels: {count1}")
    print(f"Apr-May Valid Pixels: {count2}")
    
    if count1 == 0 or count2 == 0:
        print("No valid pixels after masking.")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    else:
        # 4. Calculation
        mean1 = img1.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
            geometry=taiwan,
            scale=5000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo()
        
        mean2 = img2.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
            geometry=taiwan,
            scale=5000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo()
        
        print(f"Feb Mean NO2: {mean1}")
        print(f"Apr-May Mean NO2: {mean2}")
        
        # 5. Validation & Final Answer
        if mean1 is None or mean2 is None:
            print("Calculation failed - None values.")
            print("<answer>C3</answer>")
        else:
            print(f"Change: {((mean2 - mean1) / mean1 * 100):.2f}%")
            
            if mean2 > mean1:
                print("NO2 levels increased in Apr-May 2020 vs Feb 2020.")
                print("<answer>A</answer>")
            else:
                print("NO2 levels did not increase in Apr-May 2020 vs Feb 2020.")
                print("<answer>B</answer>")
